title: Pixel game animation comparison: Blender vs voxel vs puppet rig vs AI video mocap vs sprite sheets vs hand-coded animation
author: virtualbudz
selftext:
Pixel-art co-op castle defense game. I tried 8 ways to animate the heroes:

\- AI drawn sprite sheets

\- A pixel "puppet": one drawing cut into parts and moved by code

\- The AI draws every body part separately, then a code rig with real bending legs

\- AI video turned into sprite frames

\- AI video as motion capture (the clip: an AI "actor" plus pose tracking drives our sprite rig)

\- Voxel 3D

\- Blender, built entirely by code

\- Hand-coded animation and effects in the engine  


What I learned:

\- AI mocap: a two-handed greatsword swung one-handed, fake kicks, and a backflip that tears the sprite apart. Chibi heroes with 5 px legs can't show a kick.

\- AI video was great for idle, hit, death and spell casts. One hero uses them in the current build.

\- Drawn walks have more charm, rigged walks keep the feet planted. I use both.

\- Blender looked great in smooth 3D, just not squeezed into 42 px pixel art.

\- Effects: hand-coded wins. A cracked floor reads better than AI rock spikes.



Full side-by-side comparison with about 50 clips: [https://claude.ai/artifact/JJcXi1efGN5qyfdTTj3UAU](https://claude.ai/artifact/JJcXi1efGN5qyfdTTj3UAU)



I also wrote the whole method up as a Claude Code skill you can drop into your own project. It's on the same page.

comments.author: cave_men
comments.body: Took me some time to realise, that the actors are ai too :D

comments.author: PSloVR
comments.body: This deserves a lot of up votes.  I'm usually seeing either "look at this" posts with no explanation on technique or workflow, or posts advertising some service.  Haven't seen a shared Claude artifact with research results laid out.  Thanks for sharing!

comments.author: Lethandralis
comments.body: Pixel art animations are supposed to be fast, flashy, bouncy and exaggerated. I doubt using realistic mocap animations as a reference is a great idea.

replies.author: virtualbudz
replies.body: Its not. I have the full link explaining how it all works best. Mocap is no good for pixel animations.

comments.author: marvellous_potato
comments.body:
Good write up. 

So many people get consumed by the whole "AI slop" movement that they are forgetting that AI is not creating these ganes. AI is simply following instructions from someone who has designed the game in their head.

It can still be used to create animations and systems in a game without being called slop!
